name: dsh-dsml-guard
description: Strips DSML markers leaked into assistant prose and resumes a turn when a 继续 genuinely helps (max-tokens, empty/closed streams, misclassified network blips), with a default cap of 3 consecutive failures reset by any normal reply; quota, auth and context-window errors are never retried; overlap with DSH's own per-provider retry policy (EMPTY_RESPONSE/SERVER/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) is delegated to the host by default (skipHostRetriedCodes). / 抹掉漏进正文的 DSML 标记，并只在「发继续能真正解决」时补发；默认连续 3 次失败后停发、正常回复清零；额度/鉴权/上下文超限一律不续；与 DSH 自带「重试策略」重叠的四个错误码默认交给宿主，不重复续跑（skipHostRetriedCodes）。
author: Jessicaisleep
